inputs.code:
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper

// ================= INPUTS =================
def accountsJson = '''
[
  {"Account":"Shaw","Total Use Cases":13,"Live":5,"UAT":5,"UAT Blocked":0,"Build":2,"Discovery":0,"Blocked":2,"On Hold / N/A":0},
  {"Account":"Docebo","Total Use Cases":21,"Live":14,"UAT":2,"UAT Blocked":0,"Build":0,"Discovery":0,"Blocked":0,"On Hold / N/A":1},
  {"Account":"AMN","Total Use Cases":17,"Live":4,"UAT":5,"UAT Blocked":2,"Build":6,"Discovery":5,"Blocked":0,"On Hold / N/A":0},
  {"Account":"Assurant","Total Use Cases":4,"Live":1,"UAT":2,"UAT Blocked":0,"Build":1,"Discovery":1,"Blocked":0,"On Hold / N/A":0},
  {"Account":"Chargepoint","Total Use Cases":6,"Live":0,"UAT":3,"UAT Blocked":0,"Build":0,"Discovery":3,"Blocked":0,"On Hold / N/A":0},
  {"Account":"Advance Auto","Total Use Cases":1,"Live":0,"UAT":0,"UAT Blocked":0,"Build":1,"Discovery":0,"Blocked":0,"On Hold / N/A":1}
]
'''
def accountsInput = new JsonSlurper().parseText(accountsJson)
def fdesInput = fdes   // bound by UnifyApps

// ================= CONFIG =================
double UNDER_UTILISED_MAX = 40.0
double ADEQUATE_MAX = 70.0
def TARGET_MANAGER = 'Pratik Singh'   // <-- change this name to filter for a different lead

def classifyUtilisation = { double eff ->
    if (eff < UNDER_UTILISED_MAX) return 'UNDER-UTILISED'
    else if (eff <= ADEQUATE_MAX) return 'ADEQUATELY UTILISED'
    else return 'OVER-UTILISED'
}

// ================= STEP 0: Build a name -> designation lookup from all FDE records =================
def designationLookup = [:]
fdesInput.each { rec ->
    def props = rec.properties ?: rec
    def name = props.fde
    def designation = props.designation
    if (name && designation && !designationLookup.containsKey(name)) {
        designationLookup[name] = designation
    }
}

// ================= STEP 1: Group FDEs under each manager (lead) =================
def leadTeams = [:]
fdesInput.each { rec ->
    def props = rec.properties ?: rec
    def manager = props.manager
    if (manager) {
        leadTeams.computeIfAbsent(manager) { [] } << rec
    }
}

// ================= FILTER: keep only the target manager's team =================
def filteredLeadTeams = leadTeams.findAll { manager, team -> manager == TARGET_MANAGER }

// ================= STEP 2: Account efficiency (out of 100) =================
def WEIGHTS = [Live:1.0, UAT:0.7, Build:0.5, Discovery:0.3]
def accountEfficiency = accountsInput.collectEntries { acc ->
    double total = (acc['Total Use Cases'] ?: 0) as double
    double score = WEIGHTS.collect { k, w -> ((acc[k] ?: 0) as double) * w }.sum()
    [(acc.Account): total ? Math.round((score/total)*10000)/100.0 : 0.0]
}

double weightedSum = 0, totalUseCasesAll = 0
accountsInput.each { acc ->
    double total = (acc['Total Use Cases'] ?: 0) as double
    weightedSum += accountEfficiency[acc.Account] * total
    totalUseCasesAll += total
}
double weightedAvgAccountEfficiency = totalUseCasesAll ? weightedSum / totalUseCasesAll : 0

def accountClassification = accountEfficiency.collectEntries { acct, eff ->
    [(acct): classifyUtilisation(eff)]
}

// ================= STEP 3: Map messy account names on FDE records -> clean account names =================
def aliasMap = [
    'shaw industries':'Shaw', 'shaw':'Shaw',
    'amn':'AMN', 'amn health':'AMN',
    'docebo':'Docebo',
    'assurant':'Assurant',
    'chargepoint':'Chargepoint',
    'advance auto':'Advance Auto'
]

def resolveAccounts = { accountField ->
    if (!accountField) return []
    accountField.split(',')
        .collect { it.trim().toLowerCase() }
        .collect { aliasMap[it] }
        .findAll { it != null }
}

// ================= STEP 4: Build lead(s) — filtered to TARGET_MANAGER, with per-FDE utilisation =================
def personUtilisationCounts = [
    'UNDER-UTILISED': 0,
    'ADEQUATELY UTILISED': 0,
    'OVER-UTILISED': 0
]

def leadEfficiency = filteredLeadTeams.collect { manager, team ->
    def matchedEfficiencies = []
    def teamDetails = team.collect { rec ->
        def props = rec.properties ?: rec
        def matchedAccts = resolveAccounts(props.account)
        def scores = matchedAccts.collect { accountEfficiency[it] }
        matchedEfficiencies.addAll(scores)

        double personEff = scores ? scores.sum() / scores.size() : 0.0
        double roundedPersonEff = Math.round(personEff * 100) / 100.0
        def personUtil = classifyUtilisation(roundedPersonEff)
        personUtilisationCounts[personUtil] = (personUtilisationCounts[personUtil] ?: 0) + 1

        def ownTeam = leadTeams[props.fde] ?: []

        [
            fde: props.fde,
            designation: props.designation ?: designationLookup[props.fde] ?: 'Unknown',
            accountsTagged: matchedAccts,
            matchedScores: scores,
            personEfficiency: roundedPersonEff,
            personUtilisation: personUtil,
            directReportsCount: ownTeam.size(),
            directReportsNames: ownTeam.collect { (it.properties ?: it).fde }
        ]
    }
    double eff = matchedEfficiencies ? matchedEfficiencies.sum() / matchedEfficiencies.size() : 0.0
    double roundedEff = Math.round(eff * 100) / 100.0
    def leadUtil = classifyUtilisation(roundedEff)   // computed ONCE, reused below — no drift possible

    [
        manager: manager,
        managerDesignation: designationLookup[manager] ?: 'Unknown',
        fdeCount: team.size(),
        fdeNames: team.collect { (it.properties ?: it).fde },
        teamDetails: teamDetails,
        matchedAccounts: teamDetails.collect { it.accountsTagged }.flatten().unique(),
        efficiency: roundedEff,
        utilisation: leadUtil
    ]
}.sort { -it.fdeCount }

double leadWeightedSum = 0
int totalFdesAssignedToLeads = filteredLeadTeams.values().sum { it.size() } ?: 0
leadEfficiency.each { leadWeightedSum += it.efficiency * it.fdeCount }
double weightedAvgLeadEfficiency = totalFdesAssignedToLeads ? leadWeightedSum / totalFdesAssignedToLeads : 0
def overallUtilisation = classifyUtilisation(weightedAvgLeadEfficiency)

// ================= STEP 5: Summary — derived directly from leadEfficiency, guaranteed consistent =================
def leadUtilisationCounts = [
    'UNDER-UTILISED': 0,
    'ADEQUATELY UTILISED': 0,
    'OVER-UTILISED': 0
]
leadEfficiency.each { lead ->
    leadUtilisationCounts[lead.utilisation] = (leadUtilisationCounts[lead.utilisation] ?: 0) + 1
}

def leadUtilisationSummary = [
    underUtilisedCount: leadUtilisationCounts['UNDER-UTILISED'],
    adequatelyUtilisedCount: leadUtilisationCounts['ADEQUATELY UTILISED'],
    overUtilisedCount: leadUtilisationCounts['OVER-UTILISED'],
    totalLeads: leadEfficiency.size()
]
def personUtilisationSummary = [
    underUtilisedCount: personUtilisationCounts['UNDER-UTILISED'],
    adequatelyUtilisedCount: personUtilisationCounts['ADEQUATELY UTILISED'],
    overUtilisedCount: personUtilisationCounts['OVER-UTILISED'],
    totalPeople: totalFdesAssignedToLeads
]

// ================= OUTPUT =================
def accountEfficiencyArray = accountEfficiency.collect { acct, eff ->
    [account: acct, efficiency: eff, utilisation: accountClassification[acct]]
}

def resultArray = [
    [
        leads: leadEfficiency,
        weightedAvgLeadEfficiency: Math.round(weightedAvgLeadEfficiency * 100) / 100.0,
        weightedAvgLeadUtilisation: overallUtilisation,
        leadUtilisationSummary: leadUtilisationSummary,
        personUtilisationSummary: personUtilisationSummary,
        accounts: accountEfficiencyArray,
        weightedAvgAccountEfficiency: Math.round(weightedAvgAccountEfficiency * 100) / 100.0,
        totalFdesAssignedToLeads: totalFdesAssignedToLeads
    ]
]

return [result: resultArray]
